from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Represents one judgment document extracted from the collection."""
    title: str = Field(..., description="The title or identifier of the judgment document")
    case_category: str = Field(..., description="The broad legal category of the case (e.g. '民事', '行政')")
    cause_of_action: str = Field(..., description="The specific cause of action or dispute nature found in the document")
    order_index: int = Field(..., description="The document's sequential index to maintain original order")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregate class containing all extracted document instances."""
    documents: list[DocumentInfo] = Field(..., description="List of all extracted judgment document instances")
